changes: Adopt the shipped package Framework prefab through a game configuration variant, preserving its full component/UI hierarchy. Remove manual module/helper/UI group/EventSystem composition and the null-resource scene-helper bypass.

ProcedureComponent uses seven serialized game procedure types and its configured entry. GameEntry resolves required components; IsInitialized handles the asynchronous startup boundary without manual procedure initialization.

Framework MvvmBindingsGenerator wires B_* widgets, while HelperFactoryGenerator and MvvmAccessorGenerator produce the game factories/accessors. VM commands follow the documented tool convention with the Command suffix; manual FpsUiBindings was removed.

Startup menu/play/pause-or-failure/return/reentry use one Framework FSM. Return and Retry wait for captured production exit completion before creating the next prefab session; duplicate/stale commands and startup exit are guarded.
Production resource preparation includes scene directories with separate scene bundle rules and rejects stale menu/scene manifests; no new bundle/Player build was executed.
